# V3.5 loading illustration and procedural waterfall

The loading background, four-frame fox sprite and ornamental empty progress frame were generated using OpenAI image generation from the user's supplied visual reference. The runtime WebP files are resized and alpha-trimmed exports. The fox pose animation and actual progress fill are independent of the illustration. There is no baked reference percentage.

Waterfall geometry, streaming water shaders, foam, mist, pool ripples, rock surface textures and proximity noise are original procedural code. No waterfall photo or video texture is used. This scene is inspired by the supplied reference composition, not a surveyed or official recreation of a real Fushimi Inari waterfall facility.

Existing world assets, licenses and music credits remain in ../v3.1/CREDITS.md. This addition does not replace those requirements.
